line.en: Paste a confusing letter. See what it asks you to do, and the dates and amounts in it. Nothing leaves your device.
line.he: מדביקים מכתב מבלבל. רואים מה מבקשים מכם לעשות, ואת התאריכים והסכומים שבו. שום דבר לא יוצא מהמכשיר.

limit: It is a reading aid, not advice, and it cannot read a photo of a letter yet.

works: Paste a confusing letter and see what it asks you to do
Pulls out the dates, the amounts of money and who to contact
A simple reading in English and Hebrew; a fuller one if your browser has a built-in AI
next: Read a photo of a letter, not only pasted text
A short list of "questions to ask them"
Save a reading to look at again
later: A version for a family member who asks you for help
en.ask: What kind of letter confuses you most?
